name: Castle
author: displayname808
description: Castle by displayname808 is a four-operator FM synth with a small world on its screen: a castle you explore while you play, whose villagers comment on every turn of a knob. It has eight algorithms and twenty ratio sets, a sine sub an octave down, saturation, noise, ring modulation and sample-rate reduction, and a drone mode. Turn orange up and the castle catches fire.
